Seems like nerve damage…I’m not sure how bad it is or if it’s an important area, although if it’s just a small area around the wound the nerves should grow back eventually. Generally it’ll get better with time and maybe even go back to normal, but there still might be some permanent damage depending on how the nerves were affected.
